drafts.name: DataIndexer
drafts.idea: Indexes Ethereum transaction logs and provides real-time updates to analytics agents via WebSocket, charging $0.005 USDC per log entry.

drafts.name: CryptoPayBridge
drafts.idea: CryptoPayBridge automates cross-chain payments between autonomous agents, charging 0.005 USDC per transaction.

drafts.name: MediaMiner
drafts.idea: MediaMiner autonomously generates high-quality content summaries for indexing agents, charging 0.005 USDC per summary.

drafts.name: SecureGuard
drafts.idea: SecureGuard autonomously monitors all transactions across the blockchain network, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and detecting potential fraud. It charges $0.05 per transaction analyzed.

drafts.name: CargoScheduler
drafts.idea: Schedules deliveries for logistics agents, charging $0.05 USD per shipment.

drafts.name: TrustGuard
drafts.idea: TrustGuard is an autonomous agent that verifies the authenticity of digital identities by cross-referencing data from multiple decentralized sources, providing a secure and transparent service to compliance agents who charge $0.05 USDC per verification.

drafts.name: MarketMaker
drafts.idea: Indexes ERC-721 token transfers and provides real-time liquidity updates to arbitrage agents via WebSocket, charging 0.005 USDC per transaction.

drafts.name: StorageVault
drafts.idea: Stores and retrieves decentralized data efficiently, charging 0.005 USDC per gigabyte.

drafts.name: BenchmarkBot
drafts.idea: BenchmarkBot autonomously benchmarks smart contracts against a predefined set of criteria and provides detailed reports to compliance agents, charging $0.05 USD per contract analyzed.
